recognize_zh: 非顯影劑頭部電腦斷層軸切面，雙側側腦室內充滿大片高密度（亮白）急性血塊並延伸至腦實質，周圍有低密度水腫，另見一小點金屬密度可能為引流管，為顱內出血的影像表現。
features: Large hyperdense (acute blood) collection filling and expanding the lateral ventricles, most marked centrally and in the occipital horns
Blood-fluid level/layering of hyperdense blood in the dependent posterior horns
Surrounding periventricular hypodensity consistent with edema or transependymal fluid
Small focal very high-density dot in the right frontal region, possibly a ventricular catheter
Morphologic cell detail is not applicable to this image type
describe_en: Axial non-contrast CT of the head shows extensive hyperdense acute hemorrhage filling and expanding the lateral ventricles, with dependent layering in the occipital horns and likely parenchymal extension centrally. There is surrounding periventricular hypodensity suggesting edema, and a small punctate high-density focus in the right frontal region that may represent a ventricular drain. This is a radiologic image, so no cellular morphology can be assessed. Findings are consistent with major intracranial (intraventricular and intraparenchymal) hemorrhage; in a hematology context this prompts evaluation for thrombocytopenia, coagulation factor deficiency (e.g., hemophilia, vitamin K deficiency), anticoagulant effect or DIC.

ddx.vs: Typically shows patchy hyperdensity within a vascular-territory hypodense infarct rather than dense blood casting the ventricular system.

ddx.dx: Hemorrhagic tumor (e.g., leukemic or metastatic deposit)
ddx.vs: Often shows an underlying enhancing mass and disproportionate edema, requiring contrast MRI to distinguish from primary coagulopathy-related bleeding.

ddx.dx: Cerebral venous sinus thrombosis with hemorrhage
ddx.vs: Shows a hyperdense dural sinus or cortical vein and venous infarcts, and needs CT or MR venography for confirmation.
